I changed WP-21 to `in-progress` and committed it. I did not change WP-12, which is still `review`.

**Why WP-12 is unchanged:** `shared_compnents/AGENTS.md` says: *"OrthoQM rows are owned by the OrthoQM team. 3DQM sessions edit only rows marked `3DQM`."* This is a 3DQM session and WP-12 is an OrthoQM row, so I left it for the OrthoQM team. If you're on that team or have their go-ahead, tell me and I'll set it to `done` in a follow-up commit.

**The commit:** `73b590c` ("BACKLOG: set WP-21 (3DQM) to in-progress") changes only the WP-21 status, from `ready` to `in-progress`. The repo was on `master`, so I made the commit on a new branch, `backlog/wp-21-in-progress`, instead of committing to `master`. Nothing has been merged or pushed. If you'd rather it go straight onto `master`, I can fast-forward it.
